title: fritillaria pyrenaica var. hispanica
intro: Fritillaria pyrenaica var. hispanica, commonly known as Pyrenean meadow fritillary, is a variety of flowering plant that belongs to the lily family (Liliaceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Iberian Peninsula, for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Fritillaria pyrenaica var. hispanica are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
